content: CLV = odds taken / fair closing odds - 1; must remove bookmaker margin from closing price first (raw comparison inflates CLV by several points); compare against sharpest market close, not own bookmaker. CLV is the least-noisy skill metric: better early indicator of long-run results than ROI/win rate; judge over 100+ bets, not 10. Honest states: closing price unavailable (no feed), line moved (compare same line only or mark non-comparable), small markets close thinly (noisier close). Typical bands: <0% worse than market, 0-2% small, 2-5% solid, >5% excellent but usually only fast/small markets. Common mistakes: comparing to wrong close, ignoring vig, small samples, ignoring stakes.
